concept_name: After the rain: a dinghy being drained
concept: A fictional boatyard worker drains storm rainwater from a wooden dinghy supported on low cradles. Her pumping turns the reflective bilge pool into a falling outlet stream whose impact animates a second shallow puddle. Wet boards above the remaining water reveal the work already done.

source_vs_authorial.requester_meaning: Create a randomly selected complex concept using the recently integrated water theme and the attached person image, then generate and test it.
source_vs_authorial.reference_observation: The supplied portrait visibly shows a face with dark brown eyes, fine eyebrows, a small nose, softly full lips and a short dark bob with a parted wispy fringe.
source_vs_authorial.reference_scope: Visible face appearance and short hairstyle only; body, role, circumstance, feelings and wardrobe are fictional authorial choices.
source_vs_authorial.agent_owned_choices: Boat, boatyard, hand pump, posture, storm aftermath, clothing, causal story, water forms, photographic position and every supplemental expectation below.

independent_direction_comparison.first_realization: A moored dinghy on moving harbor water makes the pumping vivid but risks confusing harbor waves with the emitted water and weakens the visible bilge.
independent_direction_comparison.alternative_realization: A dinghy on low cradles makes retained water, pump connections and receiving puddle separately readable while still depicting one practical task.
independent_direction_comparison.chosen_reason: The supported boat gives clear water endpoints and a believable physical action; the small task carries an understandable goal after rain.

scene_causality.preceding_condition: A rain shower filled the open dinghy and wet the quay.
scene_causality.goal: Remove the retained water so the boat can dry.
scene_causality.action_at_shutter: The worker presses a fixed manual bilge-pump lever downward with one hand while steadying the gunwale with the other.
scene_causality.already_visible_result: An outlet stream strikes a shallow quay puddle; newly exposed boards sit below a darker wet line.
scene_causality.next_possible_state: The bilge will become dry enough to wipe down; this future is not claimed as a pixel fact.

pre_retrieval_expected_observations.observation: A shallow retained bilge pool shows muted sky reflection and wooden bottom visible beneath it.
pre_retrieval_expected_observations.failure: Water is absent, opaque-solid, or appears above incompatible geometry.

pre_retrieval_expected_observations.observation: The pump has a distinguishable intake ending in the bilge and an outlet ending above the receiving ground puddle; the outlet emits a gravity-curved stream.
pre_retrieval_expected_observations.failure: The two water endpoints are spatially disconnected, intake misses the bilge, or outlet water has no plausible origin.

pre_retrieval_expected_observations.observation: The discharge impact has a localized splash with individual droplets and radiating ripples in the receiving shallow puddle.
pre_retrieval_expected_observations.failure: Splash and ripples are absent, disconnected from impact, or read as unrelated decorative water.

pre_retrieval_expected_observations.observation: Wet darkened wood and a higher wet line contrast with newly exposed inner boards above the remaining bilge water.
pre_retrieval_expected_observations.failure: No readable water-level trace or wet/dry material difference.

pre_retrieval_expected_observations.observation: Small rivulets or beads remain on the varnished gunwale after rain.
pre_retrieval_expected_observations.failure: All wood looks uniformly dry or plastic; beads have no surface contact.

supplemental_case_success: At least three distinct water forms or relations are clearly visible and connected to the same pumping task; the whole image independently reads as draining a rain-filled boat.
hard_gate_policy: Only request-grounded and actually adopted contracts produce hard gates. These agent-owned expectations are supplemental diagnostic checks, not user requirements.
generation_scope: one audited native generation, with one narrow correction only for substantive failure after review
